title: Add the major version number to the url
body:
This will add the instantsearch major version number to the url, under the `is_v` name (for `i`nstant`s`earch `v`ersion).

We currently do nothing with it yet, but this is for future reconciliation between old url and new instant search version.

The diff about `onPopState` is simply refactoring of moving the function in its own method.
